title: Document Length — 16-Page Ceiling
description: The rendered TR doc must fit within constraints.pages.max (16) pages, target ~14, measured by graders/page_grader.py against the real .docx layout. This is a SEPARATE limit from recording time: a comparison table costs page space and almost no narration, so a doc can be inside the 40-minute budget and still be far too long to read.
criterion: Estimated pages <= 16. A doc at or under the 14-page target scores 5; 15-16 is acceptable but tight; over 16 fails. A doc that is suspiciously short (under 6 pages) is also flagged, since the usual cause is dropped coverage rather than good editing.

rubric.5: <= 14 pages — inside the target, with room for a revision pass.
rubric.3: 15-16 pages — within the ceiling but with no margin.
rubric.1: > 16 pages (over the ceiling), or so short that coverage was probably dropped.

cases.rationale: Over the ceiling. The breakdown shows where to cut: an analogy on every slide plus over-long notes.

input.note: 7 key takeaways, only 5 slides — three sub-concepts absent

cases.rationale: Short because coverage was cut, which is the worst way to hit a length target.
